releaseNotes: Polish pass from the same community code review: added a CODE_VERSION constant shown in the app UI, split logging into txtEnable/debugEnable/traceEnable (debug and trace auto-disable after 30 minutes), gave component* methods explicit void return types, stopped logging raw cookie values (now logs cookie names only, at trace level), and made the 16383/32767 sentinel-value checks type-safe against either string or numeric API responses.
